description:
I Built a Robot That Can Draw Giant Images on the Beach
•••
I started with what was basically a glorified RC tank and turned it into a robot that can autonomously draw massive images in the sand. I added GPS to make it navigate accurately, then used Codex to build an app that converts an SVG into GPS coordinates for the rover to follow. After a bunch of testing and some real-time troubleshooting on the beach, I was finally able to supersize my logo and have the robot draw it autonomously.
